messages.text: Hi Ethan! Glad the car maintenance session went well. Let me know if the oil change tip worked out.
It did, thank you Marcus! Saved me a trip to the workshop. I'd love to book the bicycle tune-up next.
Anytime mate. Just send a booking request and pick a day that suits you.
Hello! Looking forward to our Mandarin session. Have you practised the greetings we talked about?
Yes! Ni hao is coming along nicely. Could we also cover ordering food?
Of course, that's a great everyday topic. I'll prepare a short list for us.
Thanks for teaching me how to build my first web page — my little bakery site is live now!
That's wonderful to hear, Aisha! Send me the link, I'd love to see it.

reviews.text: Ethan is a patient teacher. He walked my nephew through building his first web page in one afternoon. Highly recommend!
Clear, friendly and very organised. I finally understand how websites are put together. Thank you!
He helped me get my little bakery site online. I couldn't have done it without his guidance.
Very helpful and respectful. Explained everything slowly for me, which I really appreciated.
Marcus saved me a costly trip to the workshop. Practical, hands-on and generous with his time.
Priya makes learning Mandarin fun and low-pressure. Looking forward to the next session.
